Mev · Route Lookup

MEV route-decision lookup over the mev_intel.route_audit substrate (live Postgres). Returns the full builder-routing decision for a bundle: chosen_builder, alternate_builders, score, estimated_revenue, actual_outcome, actual_revenue, decision_version, submission_style. Params: bundle_id (exact), since/until (ISO dates), limit 1..200 (default 50). Backed data verified 2026-08-30: 1 row (bndl_a71_17

Mev · Stream · Builder

Canonical envelope with monotonic seq, bounded ring buffer, Last-Event-ID resume, idle heartbeat, clean termination. Polling is an implementation mechanism; events are truthfully produced from existing sources.
